attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single persistent gene.** Column 0, `phoU`, is a spine column: 100% of chromosomes carry it, all persistent, and 0% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names it in 99% of calls, with 0.04 bits.

**Then the graph opens at the `bgl` fork.** Columns 1 to 8 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 41 to 74% of calls. The model is at its least sure here: at column 1 (`bglG`) it names 68% and hesitates 1.06 bits, the most hesitant column of the window. The forks carry `bglG`, `bglF` and `bglB`, [[carbohydrate transport and hydrolysis]], and the variable columns `bglH` to `cbrB`.

**A long spine follows, columns 9 to 29**, 90 to 99% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.4 to 53% of calls. The model names 62 to 99% of genes, fewest at column 14 (`mdtL`), 62%. Then column 30 (`yidX`) is the most plastic column, in a region of plasticity in 78% of calls, and the `dgo` genes `dgoR`, `dgoK`, `dgoA` and `dgoT` sit in spine and variable columns, [[galactonate catabolism]].

**The middle spine, columns 35 to 40**, carries `cbrA` to `yidE`, [[chaperone and lipoprotein genes]], named in 68 to 93% of calls. Columns 41 to 47 are fork and variable columns, [[sugar and solute transport]], named in 85 to 96%. Columns 48 to 52 are a spine, `yidH` to `ysdE`, named in 93 to 96%.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 54 to 67 are a spine, `ivbL` to `yicL`, [[acetolactate and transport genes]], named in 75 to 94%, most hesitant at column 67 (`yicL`), 0.95 bits. Columns 68 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 36 to 53% of calls; column 69 (`yicJ`) is the most hesitant, 1.26 bits, named 76%. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.76 against 0.24 bits, and names fewer genes, 84% against 91%.

label: phoU
facts:
WINDOW: the phoU window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor phoU, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,394 to 4,473 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying phoU once); 42,506 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 89% of genes, 0.40 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,937 calls, named 93%, 0.19 bits; shell 14,240 calls, named 83%, 0.75 bits; cloud 329 calls, named 16%, 3.06 bits. Outside an RGP 29,898 calls, named 91%, 0.24 bits; inside an RGP 12,608 calls, named 84%, 0.76 bits. Columns: 49 spine, 14 fork, 17 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.76 against 0.24 bits) and names fewer genes (84% against 91%); 12,608 of the 42,506 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 69 (yicJ) 1.26 bits, RGP 53%; column 68 (setC) 1.10 bits, RGP 51%; column 1 (bglG) 1.06 bits, RGP 74%. The 19 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.54 bits on average; the other 61 columns: named 89%, 0.35 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 30 (variable), RGP 78%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: phoU. named 99%; 0.04 bits.
2. columns 1-8 (8 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 41-74%. named 68-92% (mean 86%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1, named 68%, 1.06 bits.
   1 fork: bglG S 68%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 31%, "hypothetical protein" S 10%
   2 fork: bglF S 67%; also "pentapeptide repeat-containing protein" S 19%
   3 fork: bglB S 67%; also espY4 S 17%
   columns 4-8 variable, share 47-73%, all S: bglH "carbohydrate porin" 62%, yieL "alpha/beta hydrolase-fold protein" 65%, yieK "glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase" 71%, cbrC "PF03691 family colicin E2 tolerance…" 47%, cbrB 73%
3. columns 9-29 (21 columns) spine: share 90-99%, all P, RGP 0.4-53%. Genes: yieH "6-phosphogluconate phosphatase", adeP, yieF "class I chromate reductase YieF", yieE "4'-phosphopantetheinyl transferase…", yidZ "HTH-type transcriptional regulator…", mdtL, tnaB, tnaA, tnaC "tryptophanase leader peptide", mnmE, yidC "membrane protein insertase YidC", yidD "membrane protein insertion efficien…", rnpA, rpmH, "protein YsdD", dnaA "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…", dnaN, recF, gyrB, yidB "YidB family protein", yidA "Cof-type HAD-IIB family hydrolase". named 62-99% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 14 (mdtL), named 62%; most hesitant at column 13 (yidZ), 0.34 bits.
4. column 30 variable: RGP 78%. named 95%; 0.14 bits.
   30: yidX S 70% "protein YidX"
5. column 31 spine: share 92%, all S, RGP 77%. Genes: dgoR. named 94%; 0.11 bits.
6. column 32 variable: RGP 75%. named 97%; 0.12 bits.
   32: dgoK S 90%
7. column 33 spine: share 91%, all S, RGP 75%. Genes: dgoA "2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phosphogalacton…". named 96%; 0.14 bits.
8. column 34 variable: RGP 70%. named 90%; 0.26 bits.
   34: dgoT S 87%
9. columns 35-40 (6 columns) spine: share 96-99%, all P, RGP 21-41%. Genes: cbrA, yidR, yidQ "YceK/YidQ family lipoprotein", ibpA "small heat shock chaperone IbpA", ibpB, yidE. named 68-93% (mean 84%), fewest named at column 39 (ibpB), named 68%; most hesitant at column 35 (cbrA), 0.31 bits.
10. columns 41-47 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 20-65%. named 85-96% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 44, named 85%; most hesitant at column 43, 0.61 bits.
   41 variable: ilvA P 1%
   42 fork: glvC S 82%; also yidP S 77%
   43 variable: glvA S 47% "maltose-6'-phosphate glucosidase"
   44 variable: yidL S 78% "helix-turn-helix transcriptional re…"
   45 fork: yidK S 75% "solute:sodium symporter family tran…"; also insQ S 15%
   46 variable: yidJ S 76% "sulfatase-like hydrolase/transferase"
   47 variable: yidI S 65% "protein YidI"
11. columns 48-52 (5 columns) spine: share 96-99%, all P, RGP 1-4%. Genes: yidH "YidH family protein", yidG "DUF202 domain-containing protein", yidF "radical SAM protein", emrD, ysdE. named 93-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 52 (ysdE), named 93%; most hesitant at column 49 (yidG), 0.36 bits.
12. column 53 fork: RGP 1%. named 92%; 0.28 bits.
   53: tisB S 88%; also "hypothetical protein" S 15%
13. columns 54-67 (14 columns) spine: share 94-98%, all P, RGP 2-43%. Genes: ivbL, ilvB "acetolactate synthase large subunit", ilvN, uhpA, uhpB "signal transduction histidine-prote…", uhpC, uhpT, adeD "adenine deaminase C-terminal domain…", adeQ, yicN "DUF1198 family protein", nepI, yicS "YicS family protein", nlpA, yicL "EamA family transporter". named 75-94% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 62 (adeQ), named 75%; most hesitant at column 67 (yicL), 0.95 bits.
14. columns 68-79 (12 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 36-53%. named 76-91% (mean 84%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 69, named 76%, 1.26 bits.
   68 fork: setC S 71%; also "IpaD/SipD/SspD family type III secretio…" S 20%, "BglG family transcription antiterminator" S 12%
   69 fork: yicJ P 67% "glycoside-pentoside-hexuronide (GPH…"; also "hypothetical protein" S 13%, "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIA" S 11%, "hypothetical protein" S 10%
   70 fork: sctE S 19%; also "DUF957 domain-containing protein" S 13%, "PTS fructose transporter subunit IIB" S 10%
   71 fork: yicH P 62% "AsmA family protein"; also "SycD/LcrH family type III secretion sys…" S 20%, "hypothetical protein" S 17%
   72 fork: xanP P 58%; also cbtA S 11%
   73 fork: gltS P 56%; also cbeA S 11%
   74 variable: recG P 54%
   75 variable: trmH P 50%
   76 variable: spoT P 47%
   77 fork: rpoZ P 44%; also yicG P 27%
   78 variable: gmk P 39%
   79 fork: ligB P 32%; also dinD S 18%, yicC P 12%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): bglF PTS transporter subunit EIIB; bglB family 1 glycosylhydrolase; tnaB aromatic amino acid transport family pr…; tnaA tryptophanase; dgoR D-galactonate utilization transcription…; dgoK 2-dehydro-3-deoxygalactonokinase; ibpB small heat shock chaperone IbpB; glvC glucose PTS transporter subunit EIIB; glvA maltose-6'-phosphate glucosidase; ilvN acetolactate synthase small subunit; uhpC MFS transporter family glucose-6-phosph…; adeQ adenine permease AdeQ; espY4 T3SS effector EspY4; insQ RNA-guided endonuclease InsQ/TnpB famil…; yicI alpha-xylosidase; eilA winged helix-turn-helix domain-containi…; cbeA type IV toxin-antitoxin system YeeU fam…; yicG trimeric intracellular cation channel f…; dinD DNA damage-inducible protein D; yicC YicC/YloC family endoribonuclease
